note: Training camp and preseason status for fantasy-relevant skill positions. Two origins: `workbook` entries come from the Key Injuries sheet; `reported` entries were added from published camp reports. Where both cover a player the workbook's detail is kept and the reported status is used to confirm it. This page reports what has been said — it does not predict return dates.

data.name: Christian McCaffrey
data.detail: Missed practice 8/10 with tightness. No designation attached and no timeline given.

data.name: Josh Jacobs
data.detail: Groin strain picked up in practice. Expected to miss roughly one week of practice.

data.name: AJ Brown
data.detail: Dislocated the thumb in practice and has continued to play through it.

data.name: Puka Nacua
data.detail: Groin soreness described as minor. No change to his draft standing.

data.name: DeVonta Smith
data.detail: New hamstring issue, listed day to day.

data.name: Jaylen Waddle
data.detail: Leg strain in his first camp with Denver. Expected back within the week.

data.name: Emeka Egbuka
data.detail: Toe issue considered minor, with no expected draft impact.

data.name: Ladd McConkey
data.detail: Strain picked up in camp. No concern from the medical staff; resting and limited to individual drills.
data.history: 2024: hip, shoulder and knee issues. 2025: AC joint sprain and a small knee problem.

data.name: George Kittle
data.detail: January 2026 surgery on an Achilles torn in the wild-card round. Opened camp on PUP; staying there past the start of the season means a minimum four-week absence. Seen running routes at TE University.
data.history: 2025 Week 1: grade 3 hamstring tear, missed 5 games.

data.name: Tucker Kraft
data.detail: Activated 7/31 off PUP. Says he expects to play Week 1 without restrictions.
data.history: 2025 Week 9: torn right ACL, rolled up on. Prior torn pec and shoulder injuries.

data.name: Sam LaPorta
data.detail: November 2025 surgery after 2-3 weeks of failed rehab. Fully cleared for training camp as of 7/21, having been held out of full-speed team drills before that.
data.history: 2025 Week 10: fully herniated disc, with numbness, tingling and muscle loss.

data.name: Patrick Mahomes
data.detail: December surgery after a Week 15 tear, reported as a clean repair with no meniscus involvement. Trending toward a Week 1 return and taking 11-on-11 reps. Fully cleared as of 7/24.

data.name: Bo Nix
data.detail: January surgery plus a second cleanup procedure, on a 3-4 month timeline. Cleared as a full go for training camp.

data.name: Dak Prescott
data.detail: Limited in team drills as a precaution. No history of knee injuries.

data.name: De'Von Achane
data.detail: Offseason surgery. Present at camp but not participating, and described as rehabbing.
data.history: 2025 Week 17: left shoulder injury on a hard landing, DNP all week after.

data.name: Drake London
data.detail: Described as a small injury he could have played through. Held out of minicamp as a precaution.
data.history: 2024 Weeks 9 and 13: hip pointer. 2025 Week 1: AC sprain. Week 8: hip, missed one game. Week 11: left knee PCL sprain, missed 4 games.

data.name: Rashee Rice
data.injury: Right knee LCL and PCL surgery
data.detail: Cleanup surgery to remove loose debris, on an estimated two-month post-surgical timeline.
data.history: 2024 Week 4: right knee LCL tear with PCL damage.

data.name: Tetairoa McMillan
data.detail: Precautionary. Missed OTAs but is practicing drills at camp.
data.history: 2025 Week 10: hamstring. Week 16: foot/ankle, no games missed.

data.name: Cam Skattebo
data.detail: Reported ready to participate early in camp, on a six-month timeline from the injury.
data.history: 2025 Week 8: right ankle dislocation with torn ligaments.

data.name: Harold Fannin Jr
data.detail: Did not participate in spring work. No limp observed; a continuing groin issue is the working theory.
data.history: 2025 Week 10: hamstring, no games missed. Week 16: groin in practice.

data.name: Ricky Pearsall
data.detail: Lingering PCL injury required surgery. Ruled out for the entire 2026 season.

data.name: Chris Brazzell
data.detail: Out for his entire rookie season.

data.name: Malik Nabers
data.detail: October 2025 surgery, having missed 13 games. Called uncertain for the start of the season and roughly 70% through rehab, though later reports have him on track for Week 1.
data.history: 2025 Week 4: torn right ACL and meniscus.

data.name: Isiah Pacheco
data.detail: Sprained the MCL in practice. Dan Campbell said he should be ready to go for Week 1.

data.name: Luther Burden III
data.detail: Groin injury in practice. Expected to miss around a month and the entire preseason, with Chicago hopeful for Week 1.

data.name: Zach Charbonnet
data.detail: February surgery on a 9-12 month timeline after tearing it in the divisional round. Placed on PUP 7/22 and described in July as progressing well, but not likely for Week 1.

data.name: Alec Pierce
data.detail: Spring ankle surgery; on PUP as of 7/27, but expected off it soon and on track for Week 1. Played through the issue all of 2025 without missing a game.

data.name: Xavier Worthy
data.detail: January surgery. Andy Reid described him as in the final stages of recovery and looking good. Wore a non-contact jersey in OTAs and participated in individual work.
data.history: 2025 Week 1: torn labrum and dislocated shoulder, missed 2 games without opting for surgery at the time.

data.name: Quinshon Judkins
data.detail: December surgery on a 4-6 month timeline. Coordinator called him confident and explosive at OTAs; a full participant in spring practices.

data.name: Bucky Irving
data.detail: February 2026 surgery to address ongoing instability. Spotted on-field for the last OTA practice in June.

data.name: James Conner
data.detail: Surgery after a Week 3 injury. Present for the offseason programme but limited.

data.name: Travis Hunter
data.detail: October 2025 non-contact tear in practice, surgically repaired. Fully cleared but not at full strength for training camp.

data.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr
data.detail: Procedure in spring camp. Missed OTAs but was expected to be a full go for training camp.

data.name: Trey Benson
data.detail: Slight discomfort in the surgically repaired knee.

data.name: Jordan James
data.detail: Fractured rib with no timeline given.

data.name: Xavier Legette
data.detail: Hard fall on his back and head and was carted off, but no signs of serious injury.

data.name: Daniel Jones
data.detail: Week 14 rupture. Reported cleared to do everything and participating.

data.name: Kenyon Sadiq
data.detail: Surgery for a pre-existing college hernia. Missed OTAs and minicamp, and a recovery setback is expected to cost him more time.

data.name: Jerry Jeudy
data.detail: Felt something in the hamstring and was held out of team drills as a precaution, with no major concern reported.
data.history: Recurring hamstring, hip and groin issues 2020-2023. 2025 Week 1: hamstring, missed one game.

data.name: Makai Lemon
data.detail: Spring camp hamstring injury. Did not practise in OTAs, with the leg wrapped in compression.

data.name: Jordyn Tyson
data.detail: Injury from rookie camp, likely hamstring, with continued rehab through mandatory minicamp. Pre-draft training had already re-aggravated a hamstring.

data.name: Tank Dell
data.detail: Knee injury with status unclear.

data.name: Jayden Reed
data.detail: Ankle issue, listed day to day.

data.name: Matthew Golden
data.detail: Toe issue, listed day to day.

data.name: Christian Kirk
data.detail: Calf strain with status unclear.

data.name: Jalen McMillan
data.detail: Knee injury with status unclear.

data.name: Michael Penix Jr
data.detail: Knee injury with status unclear.
